name: RunAssetSelectionScreen
domain: Backs up display memory, runs a modal selection screen, publishes an accepted selection, and restores the prior display state.
notes: Recovered from retained owner assembly, local state layouts, and the approved compiler through the family-assisted m2c workbench.
The generated void signature was corrected because the owner explicitly returns its selection result in r0 after preserving it across cleanup.
All generated register and stack-slot identifiers were replaced with role-based names before retaining the candidate.
The typed reconstruction improves the compiling family-assisted m2c draft from 201 differing halfwords to 179 while remaining four bytes over the owner extent.
A 5,000-candidate safe family-template walk produced no exact object and did not improve the byte delta; its best structural score increased the byte mismatch and is not retained as canonical source.
Exact-C adoption remains gated on an independently compiled zero-difference object.
